title: Start successor lead sessions in herdr tabs
body:
Outcome: krn-handoff starts the successor lead session in a new herdr tab (operator agreement 2026-10-30, memory herdr-handoff-tabs.md) instead of an invisible `claude --bg` job, falling back to `claude --bg` when no herdr server/pane is available.
Facts: .claude/skills/krn-handoff/SKILL.md:19 launches bare `claude --bg -n`; no herdr call in scripts/claude/context-{gauge,precompact,restart}.ts; herdr 0.9.1 (mise shim) offers `herdr tab create` and `herdr pane run`; ~/.claude/hooks/herdr-agent-state.sh only reports state and needs HERDR_PANE_ID.
Proof: a launcher script with a test against the real herdr receiver (KRN-12): tab created, command running in its pane; fallback path when herdr is absent.
